searchText: How simple of a static analysis are you thinking? We're not sure yet, <@!689161464829050960>. What is currently in the EIP is the bare minimum. We want to cover as much of what Solidity generates as we can in near-linear time and space -- otherwise the analysis is a DoS attack surface.
